description: A Java Swing-based UI panel class (KeyValuePane) for editing build configuration properties in Android development environment, supporting integration with Gradle build files and Android SDK.

classes.name: KeyValuePane
classes.description: A Swing JPanel class for editing Android build configuration properties, supporting integration with Gradle and SDK info.

methods.name: setCurrentBuildFileObject
methods.description: Sets the current build file object map, representing explicitly set properties.

methods.name: setCurrentModelObject
methods.description: Sets the current model object map, representing evaluated build properties with defaults.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the UI panel with specified build properties, creating labels and input components.

methods.name: updateReferenceValues
methods.description: Updates the options available in reference-type combo boxes based on provided values.

methods.name: getComboBox
methods.description: Creates and configures a ComboBox component, optionally editable, with item listener and document listener.

methods.name: updateCurrentObjectFromUi
methods.description: Reads user input from UI components and updates the current build file object map, marking modifications.

methods.name: updateUiFromCurrentObject
methods.description: Refreshes UI components to reflect the current build file object and model object states.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Returns whether the build properties have been modified.

methods.name: clearModified
methods.description: Resets the modified flag to false.
